manifest.name: dsh-skin-kit
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) skin toolbox: ten built-in wallpaper skins, a live tuning panel inside DSH settings, and a DIY generator that turns your own image or video into a skin.

bundle.text:
# dsh-skin-kit 的 bundle 补丁：把插件塞进 DSH 的插件名册。
# 由 `dsh-skin-kit install` 或 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-skin-kit` 接进 profile。
- insert:
    - id: ui-skin-kit
      name: 'dsh-skin-kit'

readme.text:
给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）换皮肤的工具箱。**装一次，之后全在界面里点。**

[English](README.en.md) · [功能规划与架构](docs/规划.md) · [做自己的皮肤](docs/DIY指南.md) · [故障排查](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

[](https://nodejs.org/) [](LICENSE)

- **十套内置壁纸皮肤**，一张壁纸对应一套完整配色：云海星球、比奇堡晴日、白崖小径、冷峻次元、冰川河谷、暮色湖灯、海岸霓虹、海边书屋、富士夜色、晴空仰望。
- **换皮肤不用重启**。点一下卡片，界面立刻变。
- **三个滑杆实时调参**：主界面面板不透明度、壁纸模糊、壁纸亮度。点击「设置」打开的整个对话框固定为 70%，设置之外的主界面仍可自由调节。
- **自己的图片或视频一键变皮肤**。每次上传都会新增一张皮肤卡；mp4/webm 保留原始画质和帧率，ffmpeg 只负责取色，图片和其他视频格式才做必要优化。
- **调好的皮肤能打包分享**。导出一个 `.dshskin` 文件，配色、参数、壁纸都在里面，别人导入就是一模一样的效果。
- **体检和安全卸载**。DSH 有个坑：profile 里列了却解析不到的插件会让它**直接启动不了**。`doctor` 专治这个，包括别人留下的悬空依赖。
```sh

readme.section: 装进 DSH（默认桌面端 profile，其次 web）
readme.text: npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit install

readme.section: 重启一次 DSH，然后打开 设置 →「皮肤工坊」
readme.text:
```

不想开界面也行：

```sh
npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit list                 # 看有哪些皮肤
npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit use fuji-night        # 换皮肤
npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit set alpha=0.5 blur=12
```

把自己的素材变成皮肤：

```sh
dsh-skin-kit diy ./我的壁纸.jpg --name "我的皮肤"
dsh-skin-kit diy ./城市夜景.mp4 --name "夜行"      # 视频动态壁纸也行
```

需要更多静态或动态壁纸，可浏览[哲风壁纸](https://haowallpaper.com/homeView)。它是独立第三方网站，与本项目不存在隶属、合作或授权代理关系。本项目不镜像或再分发该站素材；下载和使用前请确认具体素材许可，并遵守网站用户协议及原作者权利。

readme.section: 重启一次 DSH，然后打开 设置 →「皮肤工坊」
readme.text:
> 需要 Node.js ≥ 18.17。**不需要** pnpm，也不需要任何构建工具——绝大多数 DSH 桌面端用户机器上没有 pnpm，所以这个工具自己完成 profile 接线。
> ffmpeg 是可选的：装了可自动取色、优化图片并转换非 mp4/webm 视频；直传 mp4/webm 不转码。

| id | 名称 | 风格 |
|---|---|---|
| `bikini-breeze` | 比奇堡晴日 | 明亮海蓝、珊瑚橙点缀 |
| `chalk-cliffs` | 白崖小径 | 海岸草坡、温柔浅色 |
| `cloud-orbit` | 云海星球 | 黑色太空、蓝色地球 |
| `cold-anime` | 冷峻次元 | 雪原灰蓝、冰蓝高光 |
| `fuji-night` | 富士夜色 | 深蓝山影、暖光小店 |
| `glacier-river` | 冰川河谷 | 雪山河流、青绿冷色 |
| `ocean-avenue` | 海岸霓虹 | 紫红晚霞、街头路牌 |
| `seaside-study` | 海边书屋 | 晴海书亭、暖木点缀 |
| `skyward-blue` | 晴空仰望 | 蓝天树影、清透浅蓝 |
| `twilight-lake` | 暮色湖灯 | 蓝调湖面、暖色路灯 |
十套内置皮肤和今后新建的图片/视频 DIY 皮肤统一默认：主界面不透明度 15%、模糊 0px、壁纸亮度 100%。这组值不模糊、不增减原片亮度，并尽量少遮挡壁纸；手动参数仍可覆盖。

| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `install [--profile <名>]` | 装进 DSH profile |
| `uninstall [--purge]` | 卸载；`--purge` 连皮肤和壁纸数据一起删 |
| `doctor [--fix]` | 体检所有 profile，找出会让 DSH 起不来的条目 |
| `list` | 列出皮肤和当前状态 |
| `use <id\|none>` | 换皮肤 / 关掉皮肤 |
| `set alpha=.. blur=.. brightness=..` | 调参数 |
| `diy <图片或视频>` | 生成一套自己的皮肤 |
| `export [id] [--out 文件]` | 导出 `.dshskin` |
| `import <文件>` | 导入 `.dshskin` |
| `prune` | 清理没人引用的壁纸文件 |

通用参数：`--home <路径>` 指定 DSH home（默认 `$DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh`），`--json` 输出机器可读结果。

```
dsh-skin-kit（一个包，三重身份）
├─ CLI            装/卸/体检/DIY/导入导出
├─ DSH host 半    /api/skin-kit/* 路由 + 配置读写 + 壁纸伺服
└─ DSH client 半  套用皮肤 + 「皮肤工坊」设置分区

三个值得说的设计：

**皮肤改的是设计令牌，不是类名。** DSH 前端所有颜色都读 `--dsw-*` CSS 变量，本工具覆盖其中全部 80 个。相比去命中 `.pI_x6G_frame` 这种构建期哈希类名，DSH 升级后不容易碎。

**壁纸走 HTTP 路由，不塞进 JS。** 用户上传的素材走 `/api/skin-kit/wallpaper/<id>`，文件在 `~/.dsh/skin-kit/wallpapers/`；随包默认壁纸走 `/api/skin-kit/asset/<skinId>`，文件在插件的 `skins/assets/`。这样不会把图片或视频膨胀进 `client.js`。

**随包资产单文件上限 600KB。** `npm test` 会扫描 `skins/assets/`，任何文件超限都直接失败。原因不是浏览器加载不了，而是项目要保持 `npx github:` 首次拉取够快；十张图如果不设闸门，很容易把一个轻量插件拖成几十 MB。

**CSS 在浏览器里现算。** 皮肤编译器是纯函数，客户端自带一份，所以换皮肤和拖滑杆都不用等服务端往返。三个实时参数还进一步做成 CSS 变量（`--dsk-alpha` / `--dsk-blur` / `--dsk-brightness`），拖滑杆连样式表都不用重写，只改一个变量。

用户数据都在 `~/.dsh/skin-kit/` 下：`config.json`（当前皮肤和参数）、`skins/*.json`（自建皮肤）、`wallpapers/`（用户壁纸原文件）。十张默认壁纸随插件副本安装，不混进用户数据。
所有图片、视频、取色和压缩都在本机完成，不会上传到 dsh-skin-kit 或哲风壁纸。遇到安装、profile、ffmpeg 或视频播放问题，请先看[故障排查](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。安全漏洞请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私密报告，不要直接贴到公开 Issue。

```sh
npm test              # 58 条用例：编译器、profile 接线、HTTP 路由、客户端 DOM 行为
npm run build         # 重新生成 lib/client.js（改了 src/ 就要跑）
```

`lib/client.js` 是构建产物但**要提交进仓库**——用户是直接从仓库装的，不会自己构建。有一条用例专门比对它和源码是否同步。

版本记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
代码使用 MIT 许可。十张随包壁纸不自动继承 MIT，来源和允许范围见 [`ASSET_LICENSE.md`](ASSET_LICENSE.md) 与 [`skins/assets/README.md`](skins/assets/README.md)。

A skin toolbox for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). **Install once, then everything happens in the UI.**

[中文](README.md) · [Make your own skin](docs/DIY指南.md) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

[](https://nodejs.org/) [](LICENSE)

- **Ten built-in wallpaper skins**, each pairing one packaged image with a complete UI palette.
- **Switching skins needs no restart.** Click a card, the UI changes.
- **Three live sliders**: main-UI panel opacity, wallpaper blur, wallpaper brightness. The entire Settings dialog stays fixed at 70%, while the UI outside Settings remains freely adjustable.
- **Turn your own image or video into a skin.** Every upload creates a new gallery card. mp4/webm keeps its original bytes, resolution, frame rate and colour; ffmpeg samples colours and only optimizes images or converts other video formats.
- **Share what you tuned.** Export a single `.dshskin` file carrying palette, parameters and wallpaper; whoever imports it gets exactly the same look.
- **Health check and clean uninstall.** DSH fails to boot when a profile lists a bundle it cannot resolve. `doctor` finds those — including dangling entries other tools left behind.
```sh

readme.section: Install into DSH (desktop profile by default, then web)
readme.text: npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit install

readme.section: Restart DSH once, then open Settings → 皮肤工坊 (Skin Workshop)
readme.text:
```

Prefer the terminal?

```sh
npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit list
npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit use fuji-night
npx github:mysn777/dsh-skin-kit set alpha=0.5 blur=12
```

Turn your own media into a skin:

```sh
dsh-skin-kit diy ./wallpaper.jpg --name "My skin"
dsh-skin-kit diy ./city-night.mp4 --name "Night drive"
```

readme.section: Restart DSH once, then open Settings → 皮肤工坊 (Skin Workshop)
readme.text: > Requires Node.js ≥ 18.17. **No pnpm needed** — most DSH desktop users don't have it, so this tool wires the profile itself. ffmpeg is optional for colour sampling, image optimization and conversion of non-mp4/webm video; mp4/webm is not transcoded.

| id | Name | Style |
|---|---|---|
| `bikini-breeze` | Bikini Breeze | Bright ocean blue with coral accents |
| `chalk-cliffs` | Chalk Cliffs | Coastal grassland in a soft light palette |
| `cloud-orbit` | Cloud Orbit | Blue Earth against black space |
| `cold-anime` | Cold Anime | Snowy blue-grey with icy highlights |
| `fuji-night` | Fuji Night | Deep blue mountain and a warm-lit shop |
| `glacier-river` | Glacier River | Alpine river with cool teal accents |
| `ocean-avenue` | Ocean Avenue | Violet sunset and street signs |
| `seaside-study` | Seaside Study | Sunny sea, books and warm wood |
| `skyward-blue` | Skyward Blue | Blue sky and tree canopy |
| `twilight-lake` | Twilight Lake | Blue-hour water and warm lamps |

All ten built-ins and future image/video DIY skins default to 15% main-UI opacity, 0px blur and 100% wallpaper brightness. This leaves the media unblurred and at its original brightness while minimizing UI obstruction; manual values still override it.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `install [--profile <name>]` | Wire the plugin into a DSH profile |
| `uninstall [--purge]` | Remove it; `--purge` also deletes skins and wallpapers |
| `doctor [--fix]` | Check every profile for entries that break DSH boot |
| `list` | List skins and current state |
| `use <id\|none>` | Switch skin, or turn skinning off |
| `set alpha=.. blur=.. brightness=..` | Adjust parameters |
| `diy <image or video>` | Generate a skin from your own media |
| `export [id] [--out file]` | Write a `.dshskin` bundle |
| `import <file>` | Load a `.dshskin` bundle |
| `prune` | Delete wallpapers nothing references |
Common flags: `--home <path>` (defaults to `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`), `--json`.

```
dsh-skin-kit (one package, three roles)
├─ CLI           install / uninstall / doctor / diy / export / import
├─ DSH host half /api/skin-kit/* routes, config storage, wallpaper serving
└─ DSH client    applies the skin, renders the Skin Workshop settings section

Three decisions worth calling out:

**Skins override design tokens, not class names.** Every colour in the DSH frontend reads a `--dsw-*` CSS variable; this tool overrides all 80 of them. That survives DSH upgrades far better than targeting build-hashed class names like `.pI_x6G_frame`.

**Wallpapers travel over HTTP, not inside the JS bundle.** User media is served from `/api/skin-kit/wallpaper/<id>` and stored under `~/.dsh/skin-kit/wallpapers/`; packaged defaults are served from `/api/skin-kit/asset/<skinId>` and live under `skins/assets/` in the plugin copy.

**Each packaged asset is capped at 600 KB.** `npm test` fails when any file in `skins/assets/` crosses the limit. This keeps the first `npx github:` fetch fast instead of letting ten images turn a lightweight plugin into a multi-dozen-megabyte download.

**CSS is compiled in the browser.** The skin compiler is a pure function shipped in the client bundle, so switching skins and dragging sliders never wait on a round trip. The three live parameters go one step further and become CSS variables (`--dsk-alpha` / `--dsk-blur` / `--dsk-brightness`), so a slider only changes one variable — the stylesheet is never rewritten.

Images, videos, colour sampling and optimization stay on the local machine; they are not uploaded to dsh-skin-kit or 哲风壁纸. See [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) for install, profile, ffmpeg and video issues. Report security vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

```sh
npm test        # 58 cases: compiler, profile wiring, HTTP routes, client DOM behaviour
npm run build   # regenerate lib/client.js after editing src/
```

`lib/client.js` is generated but **committed** — users install straight from the repository and never run a build. A test asserts it stays in sync with `src/`.

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release history.

The code is MIT-licensed. The ten packaged wallpapers are separate assets and are not automatically covered by MIT; see [`ASSET_LICENSE.md`](ASSET_LICENSE.md) and [`skins/assets/README.md`](skins/assets/README.md).
